findings.message: `NotifyAsync` is `async void`, so callers cannot await it or observe its exceptions. Any exception thrown by `ReloadAsync`, such as an `ObjectDisposedException` from the DbContext, goes unhandled and can crash the process.

`NotifyAsync` is started fire-and-forget while the action keeps running and returns. It uses the request-scoped `OrdersDbContext` after the request may have ended, which disposes the context, and can overlap other work on the same context, which is not thread-safe.
The added blank line appears to contain trailing whitespace, which the editorconfig forbids.
